Mayank has combined some things.  So, am putting in these codes:

F = Either Joint Trad or Joint UL Frazierization for both guar and curr COI rates, 2nd to die
G = Either Joint Trad or Joint UL Frazier method for both guar and curr COI rates, 1st to die (Note:  Joint UL 1st to die is not handled by WMA nor Cyber at this time.  Contract is setup as single life but with actuarial calculated 1st to die COIs.  Joint Trad is handled by WMA.)
P = User Frazierization method to blend guar COI, then use % of guar for the current COI, Joint UL 2nd to die

Codes for Joint Equal Age methods:
A = JEIA method:  Use the average age of the joint insureds (round down), but if the youngest insured plus the value in the Average Age Limit field is greater than that average, default to the youngest insured issue age plus the value in the Average Age Limit field
B = JEIA method:  Add two ages.  If female in pair, subtract 5.  If there are 2 females in pair, subtract 10.  Divide by 2, round down.
C=  JEIA method:  Add two ages.  If female in pair, subtract 5.  If there are 2 males in pair, add 5.  Divide by 2, round down.
D = JEIA method:  Default to issue age of 1st joint insured entered.
